description: crewlore: the claims whose scope covers a file as it is read or edited, the claims relevant to each prompt, and a reset after compaction. Each hook runs `lore claude-hook` and exits 0 whatever happens, so a machine without crewlore is never blocked.

hooks.command: command -v lore >/dev/null 2>&1 && out=$(lore claude-hook); case "$out" in "{"*) printf "%s\n" "$out";; esac; exit 0
